snippet.title: Simpler Times - Summer Game Fest 2024 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
AVAILABLE NOW ON STEAM! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812210/Simpler_Times/

Simpler Times is an experiential, interactive meditation that rewards patience and attention with poignant moments that can be replayed like a favorite song.
